name: scora-app
description: Scora es una aplicación web diseñada para transformar tus actividades de Strava en stickers e imágenes estéticas listas para ser compartidas en redes sociales como Instagram Stories, TikTok y más.

scripts.build: cp src/config.example.ts src/config.ts || true && vite build
scripts.build:mobile: pnpm run build && pnpm run cap:sync
scripts.test:e2e:visual:accept: pnpm run test:cleanup && playwright test --project=UI-Visual --update-snapshots && echo 'Baselines updated — review the diff and commit deliberately.'
scripts.test:e2e:regression: pnpm run test:cleanup && E2E_SERVER=vercel playwright test --project=Regression-API
scripts.evals:verify: npx tsx evals/runners/verify-evidence.ts && npx tsx evals/runners/run-evals-live.ts --collect && pnpm run evals
scripts.evals:live: echo 'Live agent evals: run agent, dump evidence to evals/reports/live/<caseId>/evidence.json, then pnpm run evals:verify'
scripts.test:sync-linux: docker compose -f docker-compose.playwright.yml run --rm playwright pnpm exec playwright test --project=UI-Visual --update-snapshots
scripts.evals:grade:all: npx tsx evals/graders/code-grader.ts --json > test-results/code-grader.json && npx tsx evals/graders/merge-graders.ts --code test-results/code-grader.json --model evals/reports/latest/evidence.json
